# watchpoint_auth_profile (Resource)

A reusable, encrypted upstream-credential profile referenced by monitors via `{{auth.NAME.<field>}}` interpolation (for example `{{auth.PaymentsApi.access_token}}`). Each profile has a single `kind`; only the fields relevant to that kind are used. Secret fields are write-only: they are sent on create/update but never read back (the API response is masked), so out-of-band rotation is not drift-detected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# OAuth 2.0 client-credentials (machine-to-machine)
resource "watchpoint_auth_profile" "payments_api" {
  name        = "PaymentsApi"
  kind        = "OAuth2ClientCredentials"
  description = "Token for the payments upstream"

  token_endpoint     = "https://auth.example.com/oauth/token"
  client_id          = "svc-monitors"
  client_secret      = var.payments_client_secret
  scopes             = "payments:read payments:write"
  audience           = "https://api.example.com"
  client_auth_method = "body"
}

# OAuth 2.0 resource-owner password grant
resource "watchpoint_auth_profile" "legacy_portal" {
  name = "LegacyPortal"
  kind = "OAuth2Password"

  token_endpoint = "https://legacy.example.com/oauth/token"
  client_id      = "portal"
  username       = "monitor@example.com"
  password       = var.legacy_password
  scopes         = "openid"
}

# OAuth 2.0 refresh-token exchange
resource "watchpoint_auth_profile" "analytics" {
  name = "Analytics"
  kind = "OAuth2RefreshToken"

  token_endpoint = "https://accounts.example.com/oauth/token"
  client_id      = "analytics-client"
  refresh_token  = var.analytics_refresh_token
}

# Custom login flow described by a JSON document
resource "watchpoint_auth_profile" "app_login" {
  name = "AppLogin"
  kind = "LoginFlow"

  login_flow_json = jsonencode({
    loginUrl      = "https://app.example.com/api/login"
    method        = "POST"
    contentType   = "application/json"
    bodyTemplate  = "{\"email\":\"{{username}}\",\"password\":\"{{password}}\"}"
    tokenJsonPath = "$.data.accessToken"
  })
}

# Static API key
resource "watchpoint_auth_profile" "status_api" {
  name = "StatusApi"
  kind = "StaticApiKey"

  static_key = var.status_api_key
}

# Static API key sourced from a vault secret
resource "watchpoint_auth_profile" "billing_api" {
  name = "BillingApi"
  kind = "StaticApiKey"

  vault_secret_ref = "BILLING_API_KEY"
}

# Mutual TLS (client certificate)
resource "watchpoint_auth_profile" "partner_mtls" {
  name = "PartnerMtls"
  kind = "Mtls"

  client_cert_pem = file("${path.module}/certs/client.crt")
  client_key_pem  = var.partner_client_key
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Credential kind. One of `OAuth2ClientCredentials`, `OAuth2Password`, `OAuth2RefreshToken`, `LoginFlow`, `StaticApiKey`, `Mtls`. Immutable: changing it forces replacement.
- `name` (String) Unique name within the tenant, used in `{{auth.NAME.<field>}}` interpolation. Must match `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}$`. Immutable: changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `audience` (String) Optional audience parameter (used by some providers, e.g. Auth0).
- `client_auth_method` (String) How client credentials are presented to the token endpoint: `body` (form parameters) or `basic` (HTTP Basic auth). Defaults to `body`.
- `client_cert_pem` (String, Sensitive) Client certificate in PEM format (`Mtls`). Write-only: sent on every apply but never read back.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth 2.0 client identifier.
- `client_key_pem` (String, Sensitive) Client private key in PEM format (`Mtls`). Write-only: sent on every apply but never read back.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth 2.0 client secret. Write-only: sent on every apply but never read back from the masked API response.
- `default_ttl_seconds` (Number) Fallback token lifetime in seconds when the provider does not return one. Defaults to `3600`.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of what this credential is for.
- `login_flow_json` (String) JSON document describing the custom login flow (`LoginFlow`). Sent as-is.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Resource-owner password (`OAuth2Password`). Write-only: sent on every apply but never read back.
- `refresh_skew_seconds` (Number) Seconds before expiry at which the token is proactively refreshed. Defaults to `60`.
- `refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) Long-lived refresh token (`OAuth2RefreshToken`). Write-only: sent on every apply but never read back.
- `scopes` (String) Space-separated scopes requested with the token.
- `static_key` (String, Sensitive) The static API key value (`StaticApiKey`). Write-only: sent on every apply but never read back. Mutually exclusive with `vault_secret_ref`.
- `token_endpoint` (String) OAuth 2.0 token endpoint that issues the access token. Required for the `OAuth2*` kinds.
- `token_prefix` (String) Prefix prepended to the token when injected into requests. Defaults to `Bearer ` (note the trailing space).
- `username` (String) Resource-owner username (`OAuth2Password`).
- `vault_secret_ref` (String) Name of a vault secret (without `{{ }}`) holding the static API key (`StaticApiKey`). Mutually exclusive with `static_key`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `has_client_cert` (Boolean) Whether a client certificate is stored.
- `has_client_key` (Boolean) Whether a client private key is stored.
- `has_client_secret` (Boolean) Whether a client secret is stored.
- `has_password` (Boolean) Whether a password is stored.
- `has_refresh_token` (Boolean) Whether a refresh token is stored.
- `has_static_key` (Boolean) Whether a static API key is stored.
- `id` (String) Auth profile ID.
- `last_used_at` (String) Timestamp the credential was last used (RFC 3339), if ever.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_auth_profile.payments_api auth_abc123
```
